heading: Land acquisition
lead: Within the historical park, the Secretary is authorized to acquire lands and interest in lands by donation, purchase with donated or appropriated funds, or exchange. Lands or interests in lands owned by the State of Texas or political subdivisions thereof may be acquired only by donation.

notes.text: Amendments2009—Pub. L. 111–11 substituted “historical park” for “historic site”.
